description: npm run check (svelte-kit sync + svelte-check) exists in frontend/package.json but no workflow runs it - tests.yml only runs vitest, which is why 8 type errors accumulated unnoticed. Add a svelte-check step to .github/workflows/tests.yml (frontend job) once the three fix tickets land so the gate starts green; treat any new svelte-check error as a build failure going forward.
title: Add svelte-check to CI so type errors cannot accumulate silently
